release_gates.requirement: Pinned, hash-verified WebRTC AEC3 plus APM source revision or pywebrtc-audio==0.2.0 wheel/source with Apache-2.0 LICENSE and NOTICE reviewed for the exact revision and approval to execute it.
One documented APM instance at the exact revision with every toggle and the three NS levels recorded, including AEC3, HPF, AGC, VAD, residual suppression and stream-delay settings.
Rights-cleared paired render/capture or measured RIR room cohort with device, channel, rate, hop, delay, movement and noise metadata.
Paired echo attenuation, near-end damage, double-talk, nonlinear echo and path-change evaluation on the exact runtime and room cohort, including all three NS levels independently.
Target-device loop delay, clock drift, buffering, content and availability timing, memory and deadline budget for every level.
Independent no-reference suppressor comparison plus real-runtime missing, delayed, dropout and nonfinite controls; synthetic passthrough is not an independent comparison.
Authorized listening or an approved quality assessment on the exact runtime, room conditions and NS levels.
Provider/catalog/license intake, descriptor and public-surface review, independent exact-head approval and explicit release admission before any exposure.
